chain.missing: the rule that links consecutive records (chain-break, sequence-gap, truncation, measurement) -- the records state per-record claims and signatures, not the hash that chains them

consistency.missing: nothing: both roots, both sizes and the proof are all stated

inclusion.missing: nothing: leaf, index, proof and tree size are all stated

token.missing: the acceptance rule (which claims are required, of what type, how tagged) -- the text states claims, key and signature, not the rule
